column1: # Requirements built so far (tools/registers.py reads it). A row only when running code is verified by the
# evidence named; status says which layer is built (the entity and the procedures come in later phases).

column2: status
column3: evidence

column2: built in P0: NIA/NEA 0-2 and the protected header codec; in P1 N4 the UE NAS security context: K_NASint and K_NASenc from K_AMF, the 24-bit COUNTs with the overflow counter, the downlink COUNT estimated above the stored one (replays discarded, 4.4.3.2), integrity over the sequence number and message, ciphering from octet 8, BEARER 0 and DIRECTION; 5G-IA0 and the 3 algorithms refused
column3: U: tests/unit/proc NasSecurity (vectors from tests/oracles/keychain.py and the Python cryptography package), tests/unit/crypto; F: fuzz_nas_ies, fuzz_codecs

column2: built in P0: unknown non-imperative IEs ignored by the codec; in P1 N4 the typed IE codecs of every IE P1 interprets, each refusing contents its clause makes impossible (a section 7 corpus per IE); reporting stays with the entity
column3: U: tests/unit/nas NasIe (Clause7 corpus), tests/unit/nas; F: fuzz_nas_ies, fuzz_codecs

column2: built in P0: CP-DATA, CP-ACK, CP-ERROR codec; TC1* with the entity (P1)
column3: U: tests/unit/nas sms_test, oracle l3roundtrip; F: fuzz_codecs

column2: built in P0: RP-DATA, RP-ACK, RP-ERROR, RP-SMMA codec; timers and RP-DA from EF.SMSP with the entity (P1)
column3: U: tests/unit/nas sms_test, oracle l3roundtrip; F: fuzz_codecs

column2: built in P0: TPDU codec (SUBMIT, DELIVER, STATUS-REPORT, COMMAND, reports; TP-VP forms; TP-PI per 23.040 9.2.3.27), GSM 7-bit and UCS2; concatenation with the entity (P1)
column3: U: tests/unit/nas sms_test, oracle l3roundtrip (pycrate elements); F: fuzz_codecs

column2: built in P0: APDU codec; in P1 N3 the card: T=0 procedure bytes (61xx with GET RESPONSE, 6Cxx), status words, the ATR, MANAGE CHANNEL with 4 channels; the terminal runs the T=0 procedures
column3: U: tests/unit/uicc_card CardOs (TS 102 221 clauses), Terminal; F: fuzz_card

column2: built in P0: BER-TLV and FCP codec; in P1 N3 the card file system: MF, DF, ADF, transparent, linear fixed and cyclic EFs, SELECT by FID, path and AID, READ/UPDATE BINARY (and by SFI), READ/UPDATE/SEARCH RECORD, STATUS, ACTIVATE/DEACTIVATE, expanded-format ARR; pySim-shell over every EF comes in N14
column3: U: tests/unit/uicc_card CardOs; F: fuzz_card

column2: built in P0: MILENAGE and the AUTHENTICATE codec; in P1 N3 the card command: AUTHENTICATE in the 3G context with Milenage or TUAK from AF20 (sysmoISIM layout), RES/CK/IK, MAC failure 9862; the ME side (RES*, K_AUSF) comes with 5GMM (N5)

column2: built in P0: TUAK and MILENAGE-256 libraries (v1.x as card algorithms)

column3: U: tests/unit/crypto keys5g_test (33.501 C.4 vectors); U: tests/oracles/keychain.py (10,000 inputs)
